description: Official and standards-based references used by the specialist curriculum. No proprietary book content is embedded.

entries.title: FortiGate / FortiOS administration and CLI references
entries.summary: Official Fortinet administration and CLI references used for policy, routing, packet flow and sniffer lessons.

entries.title: Cisco IOS XE routing references
entries.summary: Official Cisco IOS XE routing and OSPF command/configuration references for adjacency, LSDB and RIB verification.

entries.title: Microsoft Windows network and service command references
entries.summary: Microsoft Learn references for network diagnostics, DNS, routing, sockets, services and Event Log.

entries.title: IETF RFCs for packet and protocol anatomy
entries.summary: Standards references for Ethernet, IPv4/IPv6, ARP, TCP/UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, TLS, SIP/RTP, LDAP and IPsec.

entries.title: SNMPv3 USM reference
entries.summary: IETF standard describing SNMPv3 User-based Security Model and message-level security procedures.

entries.title: Authorized security testing practice
entries.summary: Security labs should use explicit scope, isolated targets, evidence capture and remediation reporting.
